```{r global_options, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 13))

data_dir <- "/Users/antina/Desktop/Chemo/images"

nucleus_file <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_nucleus_measurements.txt")
endfeet_file <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_endfeet_measurements.txt")
process_file <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_process_measurements.txt")
vessel_file  <- file.path(data_dir, "IF1_vesselring_measurements.txt")

fix_names <- function(df) {
  bad <- names(df) == "" | is.na(names(df))
  names(df)[bad] <- paste0("col_", seq_len(sum(bad)))
  df
}

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

make_mouse_colors <- function(df) {
  mouse_map <- df %>%
    distinct(mouse, condition) %>%
    mutate(mouse = as.character(mouse), condition = as.character(condition))
  
  veh_mice <- mouse_map %>%
    filter(condition == "VEH") %>%
    pull(mouse) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  cno_mice <- mouse_map %>%
    filter(condition == "CNO") %>%
    pull(mouse) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  veh_cols <- if (length(veh_mice) > 0) {
    setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#9ecae1", "#08519c"))(length(veh_mice)), veh_mice)
  } else {
    c()
  }
  
  cno_cols <- if (length(cno_mice) > 0) {
    setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#fcbba1", "#a50f15"))(length(cno_mice)), cno_mice)
  } else {
    c()
  }
  
  c(
    "VEH" = "#2166ac",
    "CNO" = "#b2182b",
    veh_cols,
    cno_cols
  )
}

plot_violin_condition <- function(df, yvar, title_text, ylab_text, ann_df) {
  
  my_cols <- make_mouse_colors(df)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = condition, y = .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_violin(
      aes(color = condition),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      trim = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = mouse),
      shape = 15,
      size = 1.1,
      alpha = 0.9,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 23,
      size = 2.5,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_se,
      geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.12,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      ann_df,
      label = "p_label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_cols) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = ylab_text, color = "Mouse ID")
}

qq_band_plot <- function(x, title_text) {
  ggpubr::ggqqplot(
    data.frame(value = x),
    x = "value",
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.int.fill = "grey80",
    conf.int.alpha = 0.5,
    title = title_text,
    xlab = "Theoretical quantiles",
    ylab = "Sample quantiles"
  ) +
    theme_classic()
}

safe_shapiro <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) >= 3 && length(x) <= 5000) {
    shapiro.test(x)
  } else {
    message("Shapiro test skipped: needs 3-5000 finite values.")
  }
}

run_analysis <- function(df, raw_var, trans_var, model_trans, title_text, trans_label = "log1p") {
  
  cat("\n\n==============================\n")
  cat("Running:", title_text, "\n")
  cat("raw_var:", raw_var, "\n")
  cat("trans_var:", trans_var, "\n")
  cat("Available columns:\n")
  print(names(df))
  cat("==============================\n\n")
  
  if (!raw_var %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste0("Missing raw_var column: ", raw_var, " in analysis: ", title_text))
  }
  
  if (!trans_var %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste0("Missing trans_var column: ", trans_var, " in analysis: ", title_text))
  }
  
  model_raw <- lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(raw_var, " ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro)")),
    data = df,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  
  print(as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_trans)))
  print(anova(model_trans))
  
  tuk <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans(model_trans, pairwise ~ condition)$contrasts
  )
  print(tuk)
  
  y_max <- max(df[[raw_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ann <- tuk %>%
    mutate(
      group1 = "VEH",
      group2 = "CNO",
      p_label = p_to_stars(p.value),
      y.position = y_max * 1.10
    )
  
  p_condition <- plot_violin_condition(
    df = df,
    yvar = raw_var,
    title_text = title_text,
    ylab_text = title_text,
    ann_df = ann
  )
  print(p_condition)
  
  print(
    qq_band_plot(
      residuals(model_raw),
      paste("QQ plot before transformation -", title_text)
    )
  )
  
  print(
    qq_band_plot(
      residuals(model_trans),
      paste("QQ plot after", trans_label, "transformation -", title_text)
    )
  )
  
  cat("\nShapiro test on raw-model residuals\n")
  print(safe_shapiro(residuals(model_raw)))
  
  cat(paste0("\nShapiro test on ", trans_label, "-model residuals\n"))
  print(safe_shapiro(residuals(model_trans)))
  
  cat("\nLevene test on raw values\n")
  print(car::leveneTest(df[[raw_var]] ~ df$condition))
  
  cat(paste0("\nLevene test on ", trans_label, "-transformed values\n"))
  print(car::leveneTest(df[[trans_var]] ~ df$condition))
  
  return(list(condition_plot = p_condition))
}
```

```{r import_data}
# =========================
# Import data
# =========================

nucl <- read.delim(nucleus_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
endf <- read.delim(endfeet_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
proc <- read.delim(process_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vesr <- read.delim(vessel_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

diam <- read.delim(
  diam_file,
  skip = 1,
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

nucl <- fix_names(nucl)
endf <- fix_names(endf)
proc <- fix_names(proc)
vesr <- fix_names(vesr)
diam <- fix_names(diam)

names(nucl) <- tolower(names(nucl))
names(endf) <- tolower(names(endf))
names(proc) <- tolower(names(proc))
names(vesr) <- tolower(names(vesr))
names(diam) <- tolower(names(diam))

nucl$image <- sub("-STAT3.*nuclear.*", "", nucl$label)
endf$image <- sub("-STAT3.*endfeet.*", "", endf$label)
proc$image <- sub("-STAT3.*process.*", "", proc$label)
vesr$image <- sub("-STAT3.*vesselring.*", "", vesr$label)

diam <- diam %>%
  mutate(
    image = trimws(gsub(".tif", "", image, fixed = TRUE)),
    diameter = as.numeric(diameter)
  )

```

```{r summaries}
# =========================
# Build summaries
# =========================

nuclear_summary <- nucl %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-nuclear$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-nuclear$", label) ~ "thr",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(mean)) %>%
  group_by(image, type) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mean) %>%
  rename(
    nuclear_stat3_mean = raw,
    nuclear_stat3_thr_mean = thr
  )

endfeet_summary <- endf %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-endfeet$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-endfeet$", label) ~ "thr",
    grepl("-STAT3-area-endfeet$", label) ~ "area",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(mean), area = as.numeric(area)) %>%
  group_by(image, type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    area = mean(area, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(mean, area)) %>%
  rename(
    endfeet_stat3_mean = mean_raw,
    endfeet_stat3_thr_mean = mean_thr,
    endfeet_stat3_area = area_area
  )

process_summary <- proc %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-process$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-process$", label) ~ "thr",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(mean)) %>%
  group_by(image, type) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mean) %>%
  rename(
    process_stat3_mean = raw,
    process_stat3_thr_mean = thr
  )

vessel_summary <- vesr %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("-STAT3-vesselring$", label) ~ "raw",
    grepl("-STAT3-thresholded-vesselring$", label) ~ "thr",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type)) %>%
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(mean)) %>%
  group_by(image, type) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mean) %>%
  rename(
    vessel_stat3_mean = raw,
    vessel_stat3_thr_mean = thr
  )


```

```{r tables}
# =========================
# Build analysis table
# =========================

meta <- tibble(
  image = unique(c(
    nuclear_summary$image,
    endfeet_summary$image,
    process_summary$image,
    vessel_summary$image
  ))
) %>%
  separate(
    image,
    into = c("condition", "mouse", "region", "slice", "astro"),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE
  )

analysis_df <- meta %>%
  left_join(diam %>% select(image, diameter), by = "image") %>%
  left_join(nuclear_summary, by = "image") %>%
  left_join(endfeet_summary, by = "image") %>%
  left_join(process_summary, by = "image") %>%
  left_join(vessel_summary, by = "image") %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("VEH", "CNO")),
    mouse = factor(mouse),
    slice = factor(slice),
    astro = factor(astro),
    
    endfeet_nuclear_ratio = endfeet_stat3_thr_mean / nuclear_stat3_thr_mean,
    process_nuclear_ratio = process_stat3_thr_mean / nuclear_stat3_thr_mean,
    endfeet_process_ratio = endfeet_stat3_thr_mean / process_stat3_thr_mean,
    
    log_nuclear_stat3 = log1p(nuclear_stat3_mean),
    log_endfeet_stat3 = log1p(endfeet_stat3_mean),
    log_process_stat3 = log1p(process_stat3_mean),
    log_vessel_stat3 = log1p(vessel_stat3_mean),
    
    log_endfeet_nuclear_ratio = log1p(endfeet_nuclear_ratio),
    log_process_nuclear_ratio = log1p(process_nuclear_ratio),
    log_endfeet_process_ratio = log1p(endfeet_process_ratio),
    log_endfeet_stat3_area = log1p(endfeet_stat3_area),
    sqrt_endfeet_nuclear_ratio = sqrt(endfeet_nuclear_ratio),
    
    log_diameter = log1p(diameter),
    
    stat3_total = endfeet_stat3_mean + nuclear_stat3_mean + process_stat3_mean,
    nucleus_total_ratio = nuclear_stat3_mean / stat3_total,
    endfeet_total_ratio = endfeet_stat3_mean / stat3_total,
    log_stat3_total = log1p(stat3_total),
    log_nucleus_total_ratio = log1p(nucleus_total_ratio),
    sqrt_endfeet_total_ratio = sqrt(endfeet_total_ratio)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(diameter), diameter <= 30)

glimpse(analysis_df)

```

```{r models}
# =========================
# Fit models
# Stats are done on LOG-transformed variables
# =========================

m_diameter <- lmer(log_diameter ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_diameter, REML = FALSE)
m_nuclear <- lmer(log_nuclear_stat3 ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_nuclear, REML = FALSE)
m_endfeet <- lmer(log_endfeet_stat3 ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_endfeet, REML = FALSE)
m_process <- lmer(log_process_stat3 ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_process, REML = FALSE)
m_vessel <- lmer(log_vessel_stat3 ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_vessel, REML = FALSE)
m_ratio_en_sqrt <- lmer(sqrt_endfeet_nuclear_ratio ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_ratio_en_sqrt, REML = FALSE)
m_ratio_pn <- lmer(log_process_nuclear_ratio ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_ratio_pn, REML = FALSE)
m_ratio_ep <- lmer(log_endfeet_process_ratio ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_ratio_ep, REML = FALSE)
m_endfeet_area <- lmer(log_endfeet_stat3_area ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_endfeet_area, REML = FALSE)
m_total <- lmer(log_stat3_total ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_total, REML = FALSE)
m_ratio_nt <- lmer(log_nucleus_total_ratio ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_ratio_nt, REML = FALSE)
m_ratio_et <- lmer(sqrt_endfeet_total_ratio ~ condition + (1 | mouse/astro), data = df_ratio_et, REML = FALSE)

```


```{r results}

diam_plots <- run_analysis(df_diameter, "diameter", "log_diameter", m_diameter, "Vessel diameter", "log1p")
nuclear_plots <- run_analysis(df_nuclear, "nuclear_stat3_mean", "log_nuclear_stat3", m_nuclear, "Raw nuclear STAT3", "log1p")
endfeet_plots <- run_analysis(df_endfeet, "endfeet_stat3_mean", "log_endfeet_stat3", m_endfeet, "Raw endfeet STAT3", "log1p")
process_plots <- run_analysis(df_process, "process_stat3_mean", "log_process_stat3", m_process, "Raw process STAT3", "log1p")
vessel_plots <- run_analysis(df_vessel, "vessel_stat3_mean", "log_vessel_stat3", m_vessel, "Raw vessel STAT3", "log1p")
ratio_en_plots <- run_analysis(df_ratio_en_sqrt, "endfeet_nuclear_ratio", "sqrt_endfeet_nuclear_ratio", m_ratio_en_sqrt, "Endfeet STAT3 / Nuclear STAT3", "sqrt")
ratio_pn_plots <- run_analysis(df_ratio_pn, "process_nuclear_ratio", "log_process_nuclear_ratio", m_ratio_pn, "Process STAT3 / Nuclear STAT3", "log1p")
ratio_ep_plots <- run_analysis(df_ratio_ep, "endfeet_process_ratio", "log_endfeet_process_ratio", m_ratio_ep, "Endfeet STAT3 / Process STAT3", "log1p")
endfeet_area_plots <- run_analysis(df_endfeet_area, "endfeet_stat3_area", "log_endfeet_stat3_area", m_endfeet_area, "Endfeet STAT3 area", "log1p")
total_plots <- run_analysis(df_total, "stat3_total", "log_stat3_total", m_total, "Total STAT3", "log1p")
ratio_nt_plots <- run_analysis(df_ratio_nt, "nucleus_total_ratio", "log_nucleus_total_ratio", m_ratio_nt, "Nucleus / Total STAT3", "log1p")
ratio_et_plots <- run_analysis(df_ratio_et, "endfeet_total_ratio", "sqrt_endfeet_total_ratio", m_ratio_et, "Endfeet / Total STAT3", "sqrt")
```

```{r export_ppt}

  ppt <- ph_with(ppt, dml(ggobj = plot_obj), location = ph_location_fullsize())

}
```
